paper_title: VisuoThink Empowering LVLM Reasoning with Multimodal Tree Search
caption: The performance gain (+%) on tasks through predictive rollout search. The performance gain is calculated via the performance gap between VisuoThink (w/o rollout search) and VisuoThink.
model_annotation: The bar chart illustrates performance gain (in percent) on tasks attributed to predictive rollout search, shown for three LVLM backbones under two supervision settings (Strong Supervision and Weak Supervision). The horizontal axis contains the model categories, labeled (from left to right) GPT-4o, Claude-3.5-Sonnet, and Qwen2-72B-VL, and the vertical axis is labeled “Performance Gain (+%)” with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 30, with evenly spaced tick marks at 5-point intervals. For each model, two adjacent vertical bars are displayed: a hatched blue bar for Strong Supervision and a solid light-blue bar for Weak Supervision, as indicated by the legend at the top. For GPT-4o, the Strong Supervision bar reaches approximately 24–25% while the Weak Supervision bar is around 5%. For Claude-3.5-Sonnet, the Strong Supervision bar is about 9–10% and the Weak Supervision bar is roughly 3–4%. For Qwen2-72B-VL, the Strong Supervision bar is about 15% and the Weak Supervision bar is around 5%. The chart uses grouped (side-by-side) bars per model rather than stacked bars, and there are no additional annotations or visual emphasis beyond the hatch pattern and color coding; the model categories appear in a fixed left-to-right order rather than being visibly sorted by bar height.
